tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. A field-tinted off-white, never pure white.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Product cards, cart drawer, invoice paper, menus.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and cards. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox borders; 3:1 or more on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, prices and headings, on surface, surface-raised and field-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: weights, units, order dates, helper text, on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Brand green. Primary buttons, links, the logo mark, in-stock state; as text, on surface, surface-raised and field-soft.

tokens.name: field-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted grounds: selected filters, order-status 'Delivered', hero bands behind field text.

tokens.name: on-field
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a field fill (the primary button label).

tokens.name: rye
tokens.usage: Grain gold. Offers, price tags, the reverse mark on dark grounds. A fill only, never text on surface.

tokens.name: on-rye
tokens.usage: Text on a rye fill (offer badges).

tokens.name: loam
tokens.usage: Soil brown. Secondary brand fill for illustration blocks and the receipt header band; as text, on surface only.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, payment failed, out of stock; always with a word, on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring, 2px offset; 3:1 or more on every surface.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Bricolage Grotesque from Google Fonts, 600 to 700. Headlines only.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Storefront hero headline, one per page.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Instrument Sans from Google Fonts, 400 to 600.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Product names on cards and rows.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pressed in small batches and bottled the same week.

groups.name: Figures
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono with tabular figures for anything a customer adds up.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices on cards, cart lines and totals.

styles.name: receipt
styles.usage: Invoice lines, order IDs, tax rows.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside badges; between price and unit.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding x1.5 rhythm; between cart rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards in the product grid.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero padding; desktop section breaks.

radius.note: Soft corners, round only for pills and the mark.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, badges, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, product cards, product images.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cart drawer, modals, hero bands.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Offer pills, quantity steppers, avatars.

shadow.note: Used only for floating layers. Cards sit flat on a line.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Cart drawer, menus, toasts.
